---
name: Add a ghost bundle
about: List a published Trials Frontier ghost bundle (checked automatically)
title: "bundle: <owner>/<repo>"
---

Replace `<owner>/<repo>` in the title with your bundle's repository, e.g. `bundle: gtjeffw/trials-frontier-ghosts-jayuph`.
`scripts/ghost_bundle.py publish` and `update` open this issue for you.
